rationale.faithfulness: The headline (assembly adds nothing over compression) is pre-registered, power-backed (synthetic power 1.0) and holds in 4/4 units. The compression half of the hypothesis (C >= 0.9, prior share >= 70%) failed, and the label favours timing by construction.
rationale.usefulness: A computable detector rule from standard logs (timing flags scripts under agent identities, AUC >= 0.91), plus the warning that compression only catches replay. Assembly theory gives operators nothing.
